cases.name: a flat handler: two reads and one write through its ports, exit 0, the Cost line last
cases.cmd: P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/ beside claude/ - a deployed harness)'; exit 0; }; command -v ast-grep >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf 'ok (skipped: ast-grep is missing)'; exit 0; }; cd {{FIX}} && out=$(python3 "$P/dev/claude/skills/dev-implement/scripts/access-cost.py" cost/FlatHandler.cs); rc=$?; last=$(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -n 1); [ "$rc" = 0 ] && [ "$last" = 'Cost: 2 reads + 1 write through ports outside loops; in a loop, a lambda or a memory filter: none' ] && printf ok || printf 'BAD-rc=%s:%s' "$rc" "$last"

cases.name: --diff in a checkout: a pre-existing port call in a loop is marked and does not fail the run; an added one does
--diff with nothing changed under the roots says so, exit 0
cases.cmd: P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/ beside claude/ - a deployed harness)'; exit 0; }; command -v ast-grep >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf 'ok (skipped: ast-grep is missing)'; exit 0; }; d=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-cost-{{SID}}-XXXXXX"); cd "$d" && git init -q && git -c user.name=e -c user.email=e@e commit -q --allow-empty -m init && o=$(python3 "$P/dev/claude/skills/dev-implement/scripts/access-cost.py" --diff); rc=$?; cd / && rm -rf "$d"; [ "$rc" = 0 ] && [ "$o" = 'no .cs file changed under src' ] && printf ok || printf 'BAD-rc=%s:%s' "$rc" "$o"

cases.name: no argument prints the usage, exit 2; a missing file is named, exit 2
cases.cmd: P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/ beside claude/ - a deployed harness)'; exit 0; }; cd {{FIX}} && u=$(python3 "$P/dev/claude/skills/dev-implement/scripts/access-cost.py"); r1=$?; m=$(python3 "$P/dev/claude/skills/dev-implement/scripts/access-cost.py" cost/Nope.cs); r2=$?; case "$u" in *'--diff'*) uu=usage ;; *) uu=nousage ;; esac; r="$r1/$uu $r2/$m"; [ "$r" = '2/usage 2/not found: cost/Nope.cs' ] && printf ok || printf 'BAD-%s' "$r"

cases.name: ast-grep missing: exit 3 and one line saying the cost is stated by hand (and /usr/bin/sg, the setgid tool, is never taken for it)
cases.cmd: P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/ beside claude/ - a deployed harness)'; exit 0; }; cd {{FIX}} && o=$(PATH=/usr/bin:/bin python3 "$P/dev/claude/skills/dev-implement/scripts/access-cost.py" cost/FlatHandler.cs); rc=$?; [ "$rc" = 3 ] && case "$o" in *'cost not measured, state it by hand and say so'*) printf ok ;; *) printf 'BAD-%s' "$o" ;; esac || printf 'BAD-rc=%s' "$rc"

cases.name: the script, its project file and its four rules ship with the dev pack, the script executable, no accented letter
cases.cmd: P={{CLAUDE}}/../packs; [ -d "$P" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/ beside claude/ - a deployed harness)'; exit 0; }; S="$P/dev/claude/skills/dev-implement/scripts"; bad=; [ -x "$S/access-cost.py" ] || bad="$bad not-executable"; [ -f "$S/access-cost/sgconfig.yml" ] || bad="$bad no-sgconfig"; for r in await-member await-member-in-loop await-member-in-lambda memory-filter; do [ -f "$S/access-cost/rules/$r.yml" ] || bad="$bad no-rule:$r"; done; [ -z "$bad" ] && printf ok || printf 'BAD-%s' "$bad"
